    CV

    Martin Machtl Perfler

    Snow crystals take a long path before falling onto our beautiful mountain landscapes and to be ready to draw a line in.
    My path has led me from engineering and tightening screws on spacecraft to the question, Is this the line I want to take?. Following my inner call for snow, I ended up here, somewhere between mountains and code…
